# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(CellChat)
library(UCell)
```



# Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/sc_combined_subclusters.RData")
```



# Subset scRNAseq for KPP and KIC tumour-bearing muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(all_genes, Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC, DEGs_sc_combined)

Idents(sc_combined) <- "experiment"

KPP_KIC_model <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Pryce_scKPP", "Zhang_snKIC"))

rm(sc_combined)
```



# Read in the list of receptors that match ligands from bulkRNAseq of LLC tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_receptors <- read.csv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumour_bulk_RNAseq/receptor_lists/KPC_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", header = FALSE)

KPC_receptors <- KPC_receptors[[1]]
```


## Check to see which genes are not present in KPP_KIC_model and remove from KPC_receptors

```{r}
KPC_receptors_use <- intersect(KPC_receptors, rownames(KPP_KIC_model))

not_in_model <- setdiff(KPC_receptors, rownames(KPP_KIC_model))

not_in_model

rm(not_in_model, KPC_receptors)
```



# Get DEGs

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(KPP_KIC_model) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_KPP_KIC_model <- FindMarkers(KPP_KIC_model, ident.1 = c("Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05 and avg_log2FC > 0.2 and in KPC_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_KPP_KIC_model <- subset(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_KPP_KIC_model <- DEGs_KPP_KIC_model[rownames(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model) %in% KPC_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model)
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model)
```



# Score cells for receptor expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_receptors_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(KPP_KIC_model, features = list(KPC_receptors_use), name = "KPC_receptors_score")

means_KPC_receptors_score <- KPC_receptors_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_KPC_receptors_score = mean(signature_1KPC_receptors_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_KPC_receptors_score)
```

```{r}
cluster_colours <- c(
    "Satellite cells"      = "#FF7FBF",
    "Myoblasts"            = "#FF3F80",
    "Myonuclei"            = "#E00000",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "vSMCs"                = "#BC9D00",
    "Pericytes"            = "#8B5A2B",
    "FAPs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Tenocytes"            = "#228B22",
    "Platelets"            = "#D46A6A", 
    "Mast cells"           = "#C85C8C", 
    "Dendritic cells"      = "#B84D9E", 
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"              = "#C9A2FF",
    "T cells"              = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"             = "#5B0E8A",
    "Neural/glial cells"   = "#FF7F00",
    "Schwann cells"        = "#FFA64D" 
)

VlnPlot(KPC_receptors_score, features = "signature_1KPC_receptors_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "LLC receptors score", title = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black")
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(
  KPC_receptors_score, features = "signature_1KPC_receptors_score", reduction = "umap") +
  labs(color = "KPC receptors score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
```

## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(KPP_KIC_model_ctl, KPP_KIC_model_end, KPC_receptors_ctl_score, KPC_receptors_end_score, means_KPC_receptors_ctl_score, means_KPC_receptors_end_score, KPC_receptors_score, means_KPC_receptors_score)
```

# Read in LLC tumour (scRNAseq)

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/Tumour_scRNAseq/KPC_tumours_scRNAseq.RData")

KPC_tumour <- KPC_combined
rm(KPC_combined)
```


## Read in the list of ligands from bulkRNAseq of LLC tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_ligands <- read.csv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumour_bulk_RNAseq/receptor_lists/KPC_secreted_genes.csv.csv", header = FALSE)

KPC_ligands <- KPC_ligands[[1]]
```


## Check to see which genes are not present in KPC_tumour and remove from KPC_ligands

```{r}
KPC_ligands_use <- intersect(KPC_ligands, rownames(KPC_tumour))

not_in_model <- setdiff(KPC_ligands, rownames(KPC_tumour))

not_in_model

rm(not_in_model, KPC_ligands)
```


## Score cells for ligand expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_ligands_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(KPC_tumour, features = list(KPC_ligands_use), name = "KPC_ligands_score")

means_KPC_ligands_score <- KPC_ligands_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_KPC_ligands_score = mean(signature_1KPC_ligands_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_KPC_ligands_score)
```


```{r}
KPC_tumour_cluster_colours <- c(
    "Tumour cells"      = "#C0C0C0",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "CAFs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF"
)

VlnPlot(KPC_ligands_score, features = "signature_1KPC_ligands_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = KPC_tumour_cluster_colours) +
```
